2.text: Shamanism is not restricted to either sex. The gift of inspiration is thought

3.text: to be bestowed more frequently upon women, but it is reputed to be of a

4.text: rather inferior kind, and the higher grades belong rather to men. The

5.text: reason given for this is, that the bearing of children is generally adverse to

6.text: shamanistic inspiration, so that a young woman with considerable shamanistic

7.text: power may lose the greater part of it after the birth of her first child. She

8.text: will recover it only after several years, — with the ending of the period of

9.text: her maternity. It is also considered that all material objects in any way

10.text: connected with the birth either of animals or of mankind may be detrimental

27.text: PREPARATORY PERIOD. — The shamanistic call begins to manifest itself

28.text: at an early age, in many cases during the critical period of transition from

29.text: childhood to youth. It is also the period of rapid and intense growth; and

30.text: it is well known that many persons of both sexes manifest during this time

31.text: increased sensitiveness, and that the mind often becomes unbalanced. It is

32.text: easy to understand that this critical period of human life, which is always full

33.text: of unexpected changes and developments, is peculiarly adapted to the first

35.text: Nervous and highly excitable temperaments are most susceptible to the

36.text: shamanistic call. The shamans among the Chukchee with whom I conversed

37.text: were as a rule extremely excitable, almost hysterical, and not a few of them

38.text: were half crazy. Their cunning in the use of deceit in their art closely

39.text: resembled the cunning of a lunatic.
